products.name: MasterKey Oncology Therapies
products.description: Orally available, potent and selective small molecule inhibitors designed to target families of oncogenic mutations in clinically validated pathways for the treatment of genetically defined cancers. These therapies are discovered using proprietary drug discovery technology and are delivered as oral medications, requiring advanced medicinal chemistry and clinical development.

products.name: Silevertinib (EGFR MasterKey Inhibitor)
products.description: A brain-penetrant, irreversible, oral small molecule inhibitor targeting classical, non-classical, and acquired resistance EGFR mutations in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and glioblastoma (GBM). Developed through synthetic chemistry and clinical trials, it is designed for oral administration and requires regulated manufacturing and distribution.

products.name: BDTX-4933 (RAF MasterKey Inhibitor)
products.description: A highly selective, brain-penetrant, reversible oral small molecule inhibitor targeting broad families of oncogenic BRAF, KRAS, and NRAS alterations in solid tumors. The product is developed for oral administration and has been outlicensed for global development and commercialization.

products.name: FGFR2/3 MasterKey Inhibitor (BDTX-4876)
products.description: A selective, orally available small molecule inhibitor targeting oncogenic FGFR2 and FGFR3 mutations, with selectivity over FGFR1/4, for the treatment of cancers such as bladder and cholangiocarcinoma. Developed through synthetic chemistry and preclinical models, with potential for further development via partnerships.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Provides loans secured by commercial properties, including owner-occupied and non-owner-occupied buildings, multifamily residential properties, and construction or development projects. These loans are underwritten with a focus on project viability and collateral analysis and are delivered through in-person banking relationships and digital channels.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Originates adjustable and fixed-rate residential mortgage loans, primarily for owner-occupied properties, with most loans sold in the secondary market and some retained in the portfolio. Delivery involves in-person and digital origination, underwriting, and servicing.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Offers loans to businesses for purposes such as acquisition, expansion, working capital, and equipment financing, secured by business assets or personal guarantees. Includes SBA-guaranteed loans and commercial insurance premium finance loans, delivered through relationship managers and specialized lending channels.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides loans to individuals for home improvement, home equity, personal credit lines, and loans secured by savings accounts or other assets. These are typically secured loans with varying terms, delivered through branch and digital channels.

products.name: Agricultural Lending
products.description: Extends loans to finance crop production, purchase of farm equipment or farmland, and operations of agricultural businesses. Loans are typically secured by crops, equipment, or real estate and may be guaranteed by government programs.

products.name: Equipment Finance
products.description: Provides financing for equipment purchases to businesses nationwide, delivered through specialized national lending channels and secured by the financed equipment.

products.name: Insurance Premium Finance
products.description: Offers loans to commercial customers nationwide to finance insurance premiums, administered and serviced by the bank through specialized channels.

products.name: Government Guaranteed Lending
products.description: Provides loans guaranteed by government agencies such as the SBA and Farm Service Agency, including both commercial and agricultural loans, delivered through specialized lending teams and often sold in the secondary market.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offers a full range of deposit accounts and services to retail and commercial customers, including checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, and individual retirement accounts. Delivered through branch network, digital banking, and brokered deposit channels.

products.name: Treasury and Cash Management Services
products.description: Provides treasury and cash management solutions to business customers, including payment processing, funds management, and related services, delivered through digital platforms and relationship managers.

products.name: Mortgage Origination and Refinancing Services
products.description: Offers mortgage origination and refinancing services, including the sale of residential mortgage loans in the secondary market, delivered through specialized mortgage teams and digital channels.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Exploration, extraction, and sale of natural gas produced from company-operated wells in the Utica, Marcellus, and SCOOP basins. Production involves physical drilling, completion, and operation of wells, with sales to external purchasers under spot and term contracts.

products.name: Crude Oil and Condensate Production and Sales
products.description: Exploration, extraction, and sale of crude oil and condensate from company-operated wells in the Utica, Marcellus, and SCOOP basins. Involves physical drilling, completion, and operation of wells, with oil sold under spot and term contracts.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of natural gas liquids (NGLs) such as ethane, propane, and butane, separated from produced gas streams at processing facilities. NGLs are sold to external purchasers under spot and term contracts.

products.name: Ski/Wake Boats
products.description: Premium inboard ski, wakeboarding, and wake surfing boats manufactured under the MasterCraft brand, produced through physical manufacturing and sold via independent dealers for both recreational and competitive use.

products.name: Pontoon Boats
products.description: Luxury and recreational pontoon boats manufactured under the Crest and Balise brands, produced through physical manufacturing and sold via dealer networks, including models with eco-friendly electric propulsion.

products.name: Boat Trailers
products.description: Custom trailers designed and manufactured to match the size and design of MasterCraft boats, produced through physical manufacturing and sold as accessories to boat customers.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts and Accessories
products.description: A range of aftermarket parts and accessories for boats, including upgrades and replacement components, sold to customers for maintenance and customization.

products.name: Laboratory and Technical Furniture
products.description: Design, manufacture, and installation of laboratory, healthcare, and technical furniture including steel and wood casework, adaptable modular systems, moveable workstations, benches, and epoxy resin work surfaces and sinks. Products are physically manufactured and often installed as part of building construction projects.

products.name: Fume Hoods and Airflow Products
products.description: Manufacture and supply of fume hoods and related airflow products for laboratory safety and ventilation. These are physically manufactured and installed in laboratory environments.

products.name: Biological Safety Cabinets and Laboratory Equipment
products.description: Manufacture and sale of biological safety cabinets, CO2 incubators, ultralow freezers, animal handling equipment, pharmacy compounding isolators, and related laboratory equipment. These are specialized, regulated products for laboratory safety and research, physically manufactured and distributed globally.

products.name: Laboratory Facility Design and Project Management Services
products.description: Provision of facility design, detailed engineering construction, and project management services for laboratories, from planning through testing and commissioning. Delivered through in-person human labor and technical expertise, often as part of large construction projects.

products.name: Dialysis Services
products.description: Provision of kidney dialysis treatments for patients with end stage kidney disease (ESKD), including outpatient hemodialysis, hospital inpatient hemodialysis, and home-based dialysis (home hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis). Services are delivered through a network of outpatient centers, in hospitals, and via home support, requiring regulated clinical infrastructure and skilled healthcare professionals.

products.name: International Dialysis Services
products.description: Operation and management of outpatient dialysis centers in 14 countries outside the U.S., providing kidney dialysis treatments to patients with ESKD. Services are delivered through physical centers staffed by clinical teams and require compliance with local healthcare regulations.

products.name: Integrated Kidney Care (IKC) Services
products.description: Comprehensive care management and disease management services for patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and ESKD, including care coordination, health monitoring, and value-based care arrangements. Services are delivered through clinical teams, technology platforms, and partnerships with payors and providers.

products.name: ESKD Laboratory Services
products.description: Specialized clinical laboratory testing for ESKD patients, including routine and physician-prescribed tests to monitor dialysis adequacy and other medical conditions. Services are provided through a highly automated, separately licensed laboratory supporting dialysis centers nationwide.

products.name: Dialysis Center Management Services
products.description: Management and administrative services for outpatient dialysis centers owned by third parties or joint ventures, including operational oversight, staffing, and compliance support. Services are provided under management agreements and generate fees based on center revenues or collections.

products.name: Clinical Research Services
products.description: Clinical research organization services for drug and device development, including study design, recruitment, and execution of retrospective and prospective studies. Services are provided to pharmaceutical and device companies and are based on contract fees.

products.name: Transplant Software Solutions
products.description: Provision of software solutions to transplant centers to improve connectivity and care coordination among transplant candidates, centers, physicians, and care teams. Delivered as a digital platform to support kidney and liver transplant processes.

products.name: Going Public Consulting Services
products.description: Comprehensive consulting services to help small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) become public companies on suitable stock markets and exchanges. Delivered by a professional team with expertise in international finance, capital markets, and cross-border listing, involving legal, regulatory, and operational support throughout the IPO process. Services are provided directly to clients and may include coordination with third-party providers such as investment banks and law firms.

products.name: Asset Management Services (Discontinued)
products.description: Management of a private equity fund, including investment management and advisory services for directional long and short investments in equity securities and ADRs. This service was provided through ATIF USA and its subsidiaries, but ceased as of August 1, 2022, when the company sold its interests in the fund's general partner and ceased to be the investment manager.

products.name: Event Execution and Planning Services (Discontinued)
products.description: Event execution and planning services, including organizing financial forums, going public briefings, and international financial lectures for SMEs. These services were previously offered through the company's former subsidiary LGC, but were discontinued following the sale of LGC in January 2021.

products.name: Electric Transmission and Distribution Services
products.description: CenterPoint Energy, through its subsidiaries Houston Electric and Indiana Electric, provides regulated electric transmission and distribution services, delivering electricity from power plants to substations and from substations to retail electric customers. This service requires extensive regulated infrastructure, including the construction, operation, and maintenance of transmission and distribution facilities.

products.name: Electric Generation and Wholesale Power Sales
products.description: Indiana Electric (SIGECO) owns and operates electric generation assets, including coal, solar, and wind facilities, to serve its retail electric customers and sells excess power into the wholesale market. This involves physical generation of electricity and participation in regional energy markets.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution Services
products.description: CenterPoint Energy and CERC provide regulated intrastate natural gas sales, transportation, and storage services to residential, commercial, industrial, and transportation customers. This requires regulated pipeline infrastructure, storage facilities, and ongoing operations and maintenance.

products.name: Residential Appliance Repair and Maintenance Services
products.description: In Minnesota, CenterPoint Energy’s natural gas distribution business provides residential appliance repair and maintenance services, including HVAC equipment sales. This service is delivered through in-person human labor and technical expertise.

products.name: Home Repair Protection Plans
products.description: CenterPoint Energy offers home repair protection plans to natural gas customers in Indiana, Ohio, and Texas through a third party. These plans are sold as a service product to external customers.

products.name: Theatrical Exhibition Services
products.description: Operation of movie theatres offering film screenings, including traditional, independent, foreign films, and special content such as performing arts, music, and sports. Delivered via physical venues with advanced projection and sound technologies across the U.S. and Europe.

products.name: Food and Beverage Services (including Dine-In and Alcohol)
products.description: Provision of food and beverage products at theatres, including traditional concessions, made-to-order meals, dine-in options, premium snacks, and alcoholic beverages. Delivered through in-person service at theatre locations, with some options for seat-side or delivery service.

products.name: Premium Large Format (PLF) and Enhanced Screen Experiences
products.description: Offering premium movie experiences through advanced formats such as IMAX, Dolby Cinema, SCREENX, 4DX, in-house PLF brands, and extra-large screens. Requires investment in specialized projection, sound, and seating technologies at physical theatre locations.

products.name: Loyalty and Subscription Programs
products.description: Customer loyalty and subscription programs (e.g., AMC Stubs, A-List) that provide rewards, discounts, and exclusive benefits. Delivered digitally and in-person, requiring technology infrastructure and marketing.

products.name: On-Screen Advertising
products.description: Sale of advertising displayed on theatre screens before movie showings. Delivered via digital projection systems in physical theatres, leveraging audience reach.

products.name: Theatre Auditorium Rentals and Private Events
products.description: Rental of theatre auditoriums for private events, including private theatre rentals and special occasions. Delivered through physical theatre locations with staff support.

products.name: Online and Mobile Ticketing Services
products.description: Provision of online and mobile ticket sales for movie showtimes, including reserved seating and pre-ordering of food and beverages. Delivered via proprietary and third-party digital platforms.

products.name: Retail Packaged Food Products (Popcorn and Candy)
products.description: Sale of branded packaged food products such as AMC Theatres Perfectly Popcorn (ready-to-eat, microwaveable, and to-go) and AMC Cinema Sweets candy, available in grocery stores, online, and at theatres. Requires food manufacturing, distribution, and retail partnerships.

products.name: Theatrical Film Distribution
products.description: Distribution of select films and special events (e.g., concert films, album listening experiences) to theatres, both domestically and globally. Involves partnerships with sub-distributors and event promotion.

products.name: Gift Card and Exchange Ticket Sales
products.description: Sale of gift cards and exchange tickets for use at AMC theatres. Delivered through physical and digital channels, supporting customer gifting and prepayment.

products.name: Galleri Multi-Cancer Early Detection Test
products.description: A laboratory-developed blood test that screens for a cancer signal shared by over 50 types of cancer, using a proprietary targeted methylation platform and machine learning algorithms to detect abnormal DNA methylation patterns and predict the cancer signal of origin (CSO). The test is processed in a high-capacity, automated laboratory and delivered to healthcare providers and patients through various channels, including health systems, employers, digital health platforms, payors, and life insurance providers.

products.name: Precision Oncology Research Use Only (RUO) Targeted Methylation Platform
products.description: A research-use-only targeted methylation platform with customizable classifiers, offered primarily to biopharmaceutical companies and research partners for applications such as pre- and post-treatment prognosis, minimal residual disease detection, recurrence and relapse monitoring, biomarker discovery, and companion diagnostic development. The platform analyzes cfDNA from blood samples using proprietary methylation assays and machine learning, supporting both prospective and retrospective research studies.

products.name: Diagnostic Aid for Cancer (DAC)
products.description: A blood-based test leveraging the proprietary methylation platform to assist clinicians in accelerating diagnostic resolution for patients with non-specific signs and symptoms but with a clinical suspicion of cancer. The DAC is designed to be used as a diagnostic aid in symptomatic populations, supporting clinical decision-making and referral pathways.

products.name: Refined Petroleum Products
products.description: Manufactured at 15 petroleum refineries, these products include gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, heating oil, low-sulfur fuel oil, high-sulfur fuel oil, asphalt, and aromatics. Production involves large-scale physical refining of crude oil and distribution via pipeline, truck, rail, ship, and barge to wholesale and bulk customers globally.

products.name: Renewable Diesel and Renewable Naphtha
products.description: Produced at two DGD plants using waste and renewable feedstocks via advanced hydroprocessing, these low-carbon fuels are interchangeable with petroleum-based diesel and gasoline blendstocks. Distributed domestically and internationally by rail, ship, and barge.

products.name: Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF)
products.description: Produced at the DGD Port Arthur Plant using the HEFA process from waste and renewable feedstocks, neat SAF is a renewable jet fuel blending component that can be blended up to 50% with conventional jet fuel for aviation use. Distributed to domestic and international markets.

products.name: Ethanol
products.description: Produced at 12 dry mill ethanol plants in the U.S. Midwest by processing corn, ethanol is sold in bulk and export markets primarily for blending into gasoline. Distribution is via rail, truck, ship, and barge.

products.name: Distillers Grains and Syrup (Livestock Feed Co-products)
products.description: Co-products from ethanol production, including dry distillers grains (DDGs) and syrup, are sold primarily as animal feed to customers in the U.S., Mexico, and Asia. Produced at ethanol plants and distributed via rail, truck, ship, and barge.

products.name: Healthcare Consulting and Managed Services
products.description: Comprehensive consulting and managed services for healthcare organizations, including financial and operational performance improvement, revenue cycle management, organizational transformation, strategy, and innovation. Delivered through in-person and remote professional expertise, often combined with digital solutions.

products.name: Healthcare Digital Services and Software Products
products.description: Technology and analytics services for healthcare clients, including implementation and management of EHR, ERP, EPM, CRM, data management, AI, automation, and proprietary healthcare software products. Delivered digitally and through technology-enabled managed services.

products.name: Education Consulting and Managed Services
products.description: Consulting and managed services for educational institutions, covering research administration, finance, operations, talent strategy, student and academic strategy, and advancement/fundraising. Delivered by professional consultants, often integrated with digital solutions.

products.name: Education Digital Services and Software Products
products.description: Digital and technology services for education clients, including implementation and management of student information, ERP, EPM, CRM systems, data management, AI, automation, and proprietary software such as the Huron Research Suite. Delivered digitally and via technology-enabled managed services.

products.name: Commercial Consulting and Managed Services
products.description: Consulting and managed services for commercial clients across industries, including strategy, operations, financial and capital advisory, regulatory compliance, risk management, and performance improvement. Delivered by industry experts through in-person and remote engagements.

products.name: Commercial Digital Services and Software Products
products.description: Digital and technology services for commercial clients, including implementation and management of ERP, supply chain, industry-specific systems, data management, AI, automation, and proprietary software products. Delivered digitally and through technology-enabled managed services.

products.name: Proprietary Software Products
products.description: A suite of proprietary software products, including Huron Research Suite, Huron Intelligence™ Rounding, and Huron Intelligence™ Analytic Suite, designed to address client challenges in research administration, healthcare analytics, and operational improvement. Delivered as digital solutions, often integrated with consulting and managed services.

products.name: Industrial and MRO Products Distribution
products.description: Distribution of a wide array of industrial and maintenance, repair and operation (MRO) products, including storage and shelving, safety and security, carts and trucks, HVAC and fans, furniture and decor, material handling, janitorial and facility maintenance, workbenches and shop desks, tools and instruments, plumbing and pumps, office and school supplies, packaging and shipping, lighting and electrical, foodservice and retail, medical and laboratory, motors and power transmission, building supplies, machining, fasteners and hardware, vehicle maintenance, and raw materials. Products are sourced from national brands, private brands, and vendor partners, and delivered via e-commerce, catalogs, and direct sales.

products.name: Private Brand Industrial Products
products.description: Sale of private brand industrial and MRO products manufactured to the company's own design and marketed under proprietary trademarks. These products are sourced from third-party manufacturers and offered as higher margin alternatives to national brands.

products.name: Material Handling Products
products.description: Distribution of material handling equipment and products, including those acquired through Indoff LLC, marketed to business customers in North America. Products are sourced from manufacturers and distributed via direct marketing and e-commerce.

products.name: Commercial Interiors and Business Products
products.description: Distribution of commercial interiors and business products, including office furniture and related equipment, primarily to business customers. Products are sourced from manufacturers and distributed through direct marketing and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Equipment Services
products.description: Provision of equipment services related to key equipment categories, including installation, maintenance, and support, following the acquisition of an equipment service provider. Services are delivered by specialized personnel to business customers.

products.name: Aerospace, Space, and Defense Aluminum Products
products.description: Technically advanced aluminum alloy plates, sheets, and extrusions manufactured through rolling and extrusion processes, supplied to aerospace, space, and defense industries. Products are often mission-critical and require long qualification periods and close customer collaboration.

products.name: Packaging Aluminum Rolled Products
products.description: Customized rolled aluminum sheet products, including canstock, closure stock, and foilstock, produced through hot and cold rolling for the beverage, food, and flexible packaging markets. Products are subject to stringent customer requirements and qualification processes.

products.name: Automotive Rolled Products
products.description: Technically advanced rolled aluminum sheet products such as Auto Body Sheet (ABS), heat exchanger materials, and battery foil, manufactured through rolling processes for automotive OEMs. Products are used for lightweighting and improving vehicle performance.

products.name: Automotive Structural Components
products.description: Technologically advanced aluminum structural solutions including crash management systems, body structures, side impact beams, and battery enclosure components, produced via extrusion, machining, and assembly for automotive manufacturers. These are fully-fabricated systems tailored for safety and lightweighting.

products.name: Aluminum Extruded Products for Transportation and Industry
products.description: Soft and hard alloy extrusions and large profiles manufactured by forcing heated aluminum billets through dies, used in automotive, rail, commercial transportation, and general industrial applications. Products are supplied as semi-fabricated or fully-fabricated components.

products.name: Aluminum Recycling Services
products.description: Recycling of aluminum scrap, including used beverage cans and production scrap, both for internal use and as a service to customers. This involves collection, processing, and remelting of scrap to produce new slabs and billets.

products.name: Downstream Technology and Technical Support Services
products.description: Comprehensive downstream services including pre-machining, surface treatment, R&D, and technical support, provided alongside aluminum products to enhance customer value and support product integration.

products.name: Casino Gaming Operations
products.description: Operation of brick-and-mortar casinos offering slot machines, table games (including poker), keno, and other gaming activities. Requires physical properties, regulated infrastructure, and in-person human labor.

products.name: Online Sports Betting and iGaming
products.description: Provision of online sports betting and digital casino games (slots, table games, live dealer, video poker) via proprietary apps and platforms. Delivered digitally, requires technology infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Retail Sports Betting and Horse Race Wagering
products.description: Operation of in-person sportsbooks and racebooks at physical locations, offering sports and horse race betting. Requires regulated, staffed facilities within casino properties.

products.name: Hotel Accommodations
products.description: Provision of hotel rooms and suites at company-owned or managed properties, serving both casino and non-casino guests. Requires physical real estate, hospitality staff, and regulated operations.

products.name: Food and Beverage Services
products.description: Operation of dining venues, bars, nightclubs, and lounges within casino and hotel properties, offering a range of food and beverage options. Requires physical venues, culinary staff, and regulated food service operations.

products.name: Entertainment and Event Venues
products.description: Operation of entertainment venues hosting concerts, shows, and headliner performances, as well as unique attractions like observation wheels and ziplines. Requires physical venues, event management, and performer contracts.

products.name: Conference and Meeting Facilities
products.description: Provision of large-scale conference, meeting, and event spaces for conventions and business gatherings, such as the CAESARS FORUM. Requires dedicated facilities, event planning, and hospitality services.

products.name: Casino and Hotel Management and Branding Services
products.description: Management of third-party owned hotels and casinos and licensing of Caesars brands and marks, providing staffing, operational expertise, and brand value. Delivered via management agreements and brand licensing.

products.name: Retail Shops and Merchandise
products.description: Operation of retail shops within casino and hotel properties, offering merchandise and branded goods to guests. Requires physical retail space and inventory management.

products.name: Aerospace and High Strength Aluminum Products
products.description: Heat treated plate and sheet, hard alloy extruded shapes, cold finish rod and bar, seamless drawn tube and billet manufactured using high-strength aluminum alloys for aerospace, space, and defense applications. Produced through flat rolling, extrusion, and drawing processes, requiring advanced metallurgical expertise and specialized equipment.

products.name: Aluminum Packaging Products
products.description: Bare and coated aluminum coil, primarily 3000 and 5000-series alloys, used in beverage and food packaging, including coated food stock, end and tab stock, body stock, and bottle stock. Manufactured at dedicated facilities with large-scale ingot casting, hot and cold rolling, coating, and slitting capabilities.

products.name: General Engineering Aluminum Products
products.description: 6000-series aluminum alloy plate, sheet, rod, bar, tube, wire, and standard extruded shapes for transportation, industrial, semiconductor, and other applications. Produced via extrusion, rolling, and drawing, these products are versatile and often require further fabrication by customers.

products.name: Automotive Aluminum Extrusions
products.description: 6000-series extruded aluminum products for automotive applications, including body-in-white structural components, crash management systems, anti-lock braking systems, and drawn tube for drive shafts. Manufactured through extrusion and limited fabrication processes such as sawing and cutting to length.

products.name: Advanced Manufacturing and Fabrication Services
products.description: Advanced manufacturing services including multi-axis CNC machining, 3D printing, welding, and fabrication for aerospace, defense, high tech, general industrial, and automotive applications, provided through the IMT subsidiary. These services leverage specialized technology and intellectual property to deliver highly engineered solutions.

products.name: Minimally Invasive Body Contouring Procedures (AirSculpt®)
products.description: A suite of proprietary, minimally invasive body contouring procedures that remove fat and tighten skin in targeted areas using patented technology, performed by trained surgeons in a single session at AirSculpt centers. Procedures require no needle, scalpel, stitches, or general anesthesia and are delivered in a spa-like clinical setting.

products.name: Fat Transfer Procedures
products.description: Procedures that transfer a patient's own fat, removed via AirSculpt®, to enhance areas such as the breasts, buttocks, hips, or hands, providing natural augmentation without implants or foreign materials. Delivered by surgeons at AirSculpt centers using minimally invasive techniques.

products.name: Skin Tightening Procedures (AirSculpt® +)
products.description: A minimally invasive treatment that permanently removes fat and tightens skin using a combination of helium gas and radiofrequency energy to create plasma, correcting sagging skin and improving laxity. Delivered as a standalone or adjunct procedure at AirSculpt centers.

products.name: Cellulite Reduction Procedures (AirSculpt® Smooth)
products.description: A minimally invasive, FDA-cleared procedure using a specialized tool to reduce cellulite on the buttocks and thighs in a single, heat-free treatment, suitable for all skin types. Performed at AirSculpt centers by trained surgeons.

products.name: Specialized Body Contouring Procedures (e.g., Power BBL®, Up a Cup™, Hip Flip®, CankCure®, 48-Hour Six Pack™)
products.description: A set of branded, minimally invasive procedures targeting specific body areas or outcomes, such as Brazilian butt lift (Power BBL®), breast augmentation (Up a Cup™), hip contouring (Hip Flip®), calf/ankle contouring (CankCure®), and abdominal muscle definition (48-Hour Six Pack™), all performed using the AirSculpt® method.

products.name: Agricultural Loan Secondary Market Services
products.description: Provides a secondary market for agricultural mortgage loans and USDA-guaranteed loans by purchasing, securitizing, guaranteeing, and servicing these loans. Involves financial capital, regulated infrastructure, and digital loan processing, delivered primarily to lenders and institutional investors.

products.name: AgVantage Securities
products.description: Guarantees and purchases securities issued by lenders, secured by pools of eligible agricultural or infrastructure loans. These are structured financial products requiring capital markets expertise and regulatory compliance, delivered to institutional investors and lenders.

products.name: Farmer Mac Guaranteed Securities
products.description: Issues and guarantees securities backed by pools of eligible agricultural or infrastructure loans, including single-class and structured securitizations. Involves financial structuring, regulatory oversight, and is delivered to investors and lenders seeking credit risk transfer or liquidity.

products.name: Loan Servicing
products.description: Provides servicing and master servicing of eligible agricultural and infrastructure loans, including those purchased, securitized, or serviced for third parties. Requires in-person and digital loan administration and compliance with servicing standards.

products.name: Long-Term Standby Purchase Commitments (LTSPCs)
products.description: Offers long-term standby purchase commitments to lenders, providing credit enhancement and liquidity for pools of eligible loans. Involves financial guarantees and risk management, delivered through contractual arrangements with lenders.

products.name: Infrastructure Loan Secondary Market Services
products.description: Provides a secondary market for loans to rural power & utilities, broadband infrastructure, and renewable energy projects by purchasing, securitizing, guaranteeing, and servicing these loans. Delivered to cooperative lenders and institutional investors, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Electric Distribution Services
products.description: Distribution and delivery of electricity to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in Connecticut, Massachusetts, and New Hampshire, including grid maintenance and operation. Service is provided through regulated utility subsidiaries and requires regulated infrastructure and in-person labor.

products.name: Electric Transmission Services
products.description: Transmission of electricity over high-voltage lines across New England, including building, maintaining, and operating regional transmission infrastructure. Delivered to wholesale and distribution customers, requiring regulated, capital-intensive infrastructure.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution Services
products.description: Distribution and sale of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in Massachusetts and Connecticut, including firm and interruptible service, and operation of LNG storage facilities. Requires regulated pipeline infrastructure and in-person labor.

products.name: Water Distribution Services
products.description: Provision of regulated water utility services to residential, commercial, industrial, municipal, and fire protection customers in Connecticut, Massachusetts, and New Hampshire, including water sourcing, treatment, and delivery. Requires physical infrastructure and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Solar Power Generation and Sales
products.description: Ownership and operation of solar power facilities, with energy sold into the ISO-NE market and proceeds credited to customers. Involves physical generation assets and participation in wholesale energy markets.

products.name: Electrical and Electronic Products Distribution
products.description: Distribution of a broad range of electrical equipment and supplies, automation and IoT devices, security, lighting, wire and cable, safety, and MRO products, sourced from leading manufacturers and delivered through a global logistics network.

products.name: Communications and Security Solutions
products.description: Provision of data center, network infrastructure, and security solutions including cabling, connectivity, power systems, wireless technologies, video surveillance, fire and intrusion detection, and access control, delivered via direct sales and channel partners.

products.name: Utility and Broadband Solutions
products.description: Distribution of products and services for electric utilities and broadband operators, including wire and cable, transformers, transmission and distribution hardware, switches, protective devices, fiber and power cable, and related services such as project management and metering infrastructure installation.

products.name: Supply Chain and Logistics Services
products.description: Comprehensive supply chain management, logistics, procurement, warehousing, inventory management, kitting, labeling, and limited assembly services, leveraging physical infrastructure and digital tools to optimize customer operations.

products.name: Digital Solutions and E-Business Platforms
products.description: Digital products and services including e-commerce platforms, digital procurement, data-driven analytics, and integration tools that enable customers to manage and optimize their supply chains and operations online.

products.name: Professional and Advisory Services
products.description: Advisory, installation enhancement, project deployment, and energy management services designed to help customers implement advanced technologies, optimize supply chains, improve safety, and achieve sustainability goals.

products.name: Renewable Energy and Energy Efficiency Products
products.description: Distribution of renewable energy products, energy-efficient lighting, and energy management solutions to help customers reduce greenhouse gas emissions and improve sustainability.

products.name: Software-Based Broadband Access Solution (cOS)
products.description: A virtualized, cloud-native software platform that orchestrates and manages broadband access networks, enabling broadband operators to deploy high-speed data, voice, and video services over centralized, distributed, or hybrid architectures. Delivered as software running on commercial off-the-shelf servers, it integrates with Harmonic and third-party hardware devices.

products.name: Broadband Access Hardware Devices
products.description: A portfolio of physical network devices including DAA nodes (Oyster, Ripple, SeaStar), PHY shelf products (Reef, Wave), Remote PHY Devices (Pebble RPDs), and OLT modules/devices (Fin, Pearl, Pier) that enable broadband operators to deliver high-speed internet and fiber-to-the-home services. These are manufactured by third-party contract manufacturers and integrated with the cOS platform.

products.name: cOS Central Cloud Services
products.description: A subscription-based SaaS offering for cOS customers that provides 24x7 technical support, a dedicated customer success team, and advanced analytics, management, and engagement tools to simplify deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of the cOS solution. Delivered digitally as a cloud service.

products.name: Technical Support and Professional Services
products.description: A suite of services including maintenance, consulting, implementation, integration, system design, installation, testing, and training for broadband operators deploying Harmonic's solutions. Delivered through in-person human labor and expertise, often under annual service level agreements.

products.name: Phosphate Crop Nutrients
products.description: Concentrated phosphate-based fertilizers (including DAP, MAP, MicroEssentials, TSP, SSP) produced from mined phosphate rock and processed at manufacturing facilities; delivered as solid granular products for direct application or blending, sold globally to agricultural customers.

products.name: Potash Crop Nutrients
products.description: Potassium-based fertilizers (primarily Muriate of Potash/MOP, both red and white grades) mined and processed at shaft and solution mines in Canada and the U.S.; delivered as granular or standard products for direct application, blending, or industrial use, sold globally.

products.name: Blended Crop Nutrients
products.description: Custom fertilizer blends combining phosphate, potash, and nitrogen products, produced at blending and bagging facilities in Brazil, Paraguay, China, and India; tailored to customer specifications and distributed through a global network.

products.name: Phosphate-Based Animal Feed Ingredients
products.description: Phosphate feed additives (e.g., Biofos, Nexfos, Foscálcio, DCP) manufactured from processed phosphate rock and phosphoric acid at dedicated facilities; sold to animal nutrition markets for poultry and livestock in North America, Latin America, and Asia.

products.name: Specialty Potash Products
products.description: Specialty potash fertilizers such as K-Mag (double sulfate of potash magnesia), produced at the Carlsbad, New Mexico facility, used for crops requiring magnesium and sulfur in addition to potassium.

products.name: Industrial Potash Products
products.description: Potash products supplied for industrial applications, including use as a water softener regenerant and for de-icing, produced at mining facilities and distributed to industrial customers, primarily in North America.

products.name: Phosphogypsum
products.description: Byproduct of phosphate fertilizer production, sold in Brazil for various industrial and agricultural uses; produced at chemical plants as part of the phosphate manufacturing process.

products.name: Biological Fertilizer Complements (Mosaic Biosciences)
products.description: Biological products and fertilizer complements designed to improve nutrient use efficiency and enhance plant growth, developed through acquisitions and internal R&D, distributed globally via existing fertilizer networks.

products.name: Ophthalmology Therapeutics (EYLEA HD and EYLEA)
products.description: Biologic medicines (aflibercept) for the treatment of retinal diseases such as wet age-related macular degeneration, diabetic macular edema, diabetic retinopathy, and retinal vein occlusion. These are manufactured using proprietary protein engineering and delivered via injection.

products.name: Type 2 Inflammatory Disease Therapies (Dupixent)
products.description: Monoclonal antibody therapy (dupilumab) for allergic and inflammatory diseases including atopic dermatitis, asthma, chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyposis, COPD, eosinophilic esophagitis, prurigo nodularis, and others. Produced via biologic manufacturing and administered by injection.

products.name: Oncology Immunotherapies (Libtayo and related antibodies)
products.description: Monoclonal and bispecific antibody therapies for various cancers, including non-small cell lung cancer, basal cell carcinoma, cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, cervical cancer, and lymphomas. These are manufactured using advanced biologic processes and delivered via injection.

products.name: Cardiovascular and Metabolic Disease Therapies (Praluent, Evkeeza, etc.)
products.description: Biologic medicines for cardiovascular risk reduction and lipid disorders, including hypercholesterolemia and familial hypercholesterolemia, as well as rare metabolic diseases. These products are manufactured using biologic processes and administered by injection.

products.name: Rheumatology and Autoimmune Disease Therapies (Kevzara, ARCALYST, etc.)
products.description: Monoclonal antibody therapies for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis, polymyalgia rheumatica, juvenile idiopathic arthritis, cryopyrin-associated periodic syndromes, and recurrent pericarditis. Produced via biologic manufacturing and delivered by injection.

products.name: Rare Disease and Genetic Disorder Therapies (Veopoz, Inmazeb, DB-OTO, etc.)
products.description: Biologic and gene therapies for rare and genetic diseases, including CHAPLE, Zaire ebolavirus infection, congenital hearing loss, and others. These products involve advanced biologic or gene therapy manufacturing and are administered by injection or infusion.

products.name: Oncology Hematology Therapies (Ordspono, Lynozyfic, etc.)
products.description: Bispecific antibody therapies for hematologic cancers such as B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma and multiple myeloma. These are produced using proprietary antibody engineering and delivered by injection.

products.name: Infectious Disease Therapies (Inmazeb)
products.description: Antibody cocktail therapy for infectious diseases, notably Zaire ebolavirus infection. Manufactured using biologic processes and administered by injection.

products.name: Colorectal Cancer Therapy (ZALTRAP)
products.description: Biologic therapy (ziv-aflibercept) for metastatic colorectal cancer, produced via protein engineering and administered by intravenous infusion.

products.name: Consumables
products.description: A broad range of everyday necessity products including packaged food, refrigerated and frozen foods, dairy, cleaning supplies, paper products, health and beauty care, pet supplies, snacks, and tobacco, sourced from national and private brands and distributed through physical retail stores and supporting distribution centers.

products.name: Seasonal Products
products.description: A rotating selection of merchandise tied to holidays and seasons, including holiday items, toys, batteries, small electronics, greeting cards, stationery, prepaid phones, gardening supplies, hardware, automotive, and home office supplies, sold through physical retail stores.

products.name: Home Products
products.description: Household goods such as kitchen supplies, cookware, small appliances, light bulbs, storage containers, frames, candles, craft supplies, and soft goods for kitchen, bed, and bath, sold through retail stores and sourced from both national and private brands.

products.name: Apparel
products.description: Basic clothing and accessories for all ages, including items for infants, toddlers, children, women, and men, as well as socks, underwear, disposable diapers, shoes, and accessories, sold through retail stores.

products.name: pOpshelf Retail Concept
products.description: A unique small-box retail format focused primarily on non-consumable general merchandise, offering a curated assortment of seasonal, home, and other discretionary products, delivered through dedicated pOpshelf stores.

products.name: Mi Súper Dollar General Stores (Mexico)
products.description: Retail stores in Mexico offering a similar assortment of consumables, seasonal, home, and apparel products as U.S. stores, adapted for the local market and delivered through physical store locations.

products.name: MACI (Autologous Cellularized Scaffold for Cartilage Repair)
products.description: MACI is an autologous cell therapy product manufactured by isolating and expanding a patient's own chondrocytes from a cartilage biopsy, seeding them onto a resorbable collagen membrane, and delivering the implant to repair full-thickness cartilage defects of the knee (and potentially other joints) via open or arthroscopic surgical procedures. The product is produced in a cGMP-compliant facility and distributed to surgeons for implantation.

products.name: Epicel (Permanent Skin Replacement for Severe Burns)
products.description: Epicel is a permanent skin replacement product for patients with deep-dermal or full-thickness burns covering ≥30% of total body surface area. It is manufactured by isolating and expanding keratinocytes from a small biopsy of the patient's healthy skin, producing cultured epidermal autografts for transplantation. The product is manufactured in the U.S. and delivered directly to hospitals and burn centers.

products.name: NexoBrid (Enzymatic Eschar Removal for Burns)
products.description: NexoBrid is a topically-administered biological product containing proteolytic enzymes (anacaulase-bcdb) indicated for the removal of eschar in adult and pediatric patients with deep partial-thickness and/or full-thickness thermal burns. The product is manufactured by MediWound and distributed in North America under exclusive license, supplied as a lyophilized powder to be mixed and applied at the patient’s bedside.

products.name: MACI Arthro Instruments
products.description: Custom-designed surgical instruments developed and sold by the company to facilitate the arthroscopic delivery of the MACI implant for cartilage repair procedures. These instruments are sold separately to surgeons and hospitals and are used to evaluate, prepare, and deliver the MACI implant through minimally invasive incisions.

products.name: MACI Biopsy Kits
products.description: MACI biopsy kits are sold to surgeons to obtain cartilage tissue samples from patients, which are then sent to the company for use in manufacturing the personalized MACI implant. The kits are a necessary component of the MACI treatment workflow and are distributed to hospitals and surgical centers.

products.name: Signal Integrity Semiconductor Products
products.description: High-performance analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits (ICs) for optical and copper data communications and video transport, manufactured using a combination of internal foundries and outsourced third-party foundries, and delivered as chips for use in data centers, enterprise networks, PON, wireless base stations, and broadcast applications.

products.name: Analog Mixed Signal and Wireless Semiconductor Products
products.description: Analog and mixed-signal semiconductor devices including transient voltage suppressors (TVS), protection devices, sensing products, radio frequency (RF) products, and power management ICs, manufactured using outsourced and internal processes, and sold for use in consumer electronics, automotive, industrial, and communications applications.

products.name: IoT Hardware (Modules, Gateways, Routers)
products.description: Physical IoT connectivity hardware including modules, gateways, and routers, designed and developed internally and manufactured via EMS partners, providing wireless and cellular connectivity (LTE-M, NB-IoT, 5G, LoRa) for integration into a wide range of industrial, medical, and commercial devices and systems.

products.name: IoT Connected Services (Cloud and Connectivity Services)
products.description: Cloud-based and wireless connectivity services for IoT, including SIM and subscription management, device and data management, geolocation, reporting, and alerting, delivered as digital services to enable customers to deploy, connect, and manage IoT devices and applications.

products.name: Oil, Natural Gas, and NGL Production and Sales
products.description: Exploration, development, production, and sale of crude oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids (NGLs) from company-operated wells in the Permian Basin, Marcellus Shale, and Anadarko Basin. Production involves physical extraction, drilling, and completion activities, with products sold under contracts to a variety of customers.

products.name: Natural Gas Gathering and Transportation Services
products.description: Operation of natural gas gathering systems and infrastructure, including pipelines and saltwater disposal systems, primarily in Texas, to transport natural gas and produced water from wellheads to processing facilities or disposal sites. These services involve regulated, physical infrastructure and are primarily used to support production operations, but may also be provided to third parties.

products.name: Refuse Collection Equipment
products.description: Manufactures refuse collection bodies, hydraulic cart lifters, automated carry cans, and related equipment for residential and commercial waste collection. Products are physically manufactured and delivered to waste management customers.

products.name: Compaction, Balers, and Recycling Equipment
products.description: Produces compactors, balers, pre-crushers, conveyors, and material recovery facility systems for on-site processing and compaction of trash and recyclable materials. Equipment is physically manufactured and used in recycling and waste management industries.

products.name: Utility Equipment
products.description: Designs and manufactures digger derricks and insulated aerial devices for electric utilities, telecommunications, and tree care companies. Products are physically manufactured and used for construction and maintenance of transmission and distribution lines.

products.name: Digital Solutions for Waste and Recycling
products.description: Provides advanced mobile and facility vision technology, integrated back office systems, and route management software for waste and recycling fleets. Solutions are digital and delivered via software and hardware integration.

products.name: Services and Lifecycle Support (Environmental Solutions)
products.description: Offers inspections, installations, preventative maintenance, repairs, refurbishment, spare parts, and training for ES products and third-party equipment. Services are delivered through in-person labor and parts distribution.

products.name: Materials Processing Equipment
products.description: Designs and manufactures crushers, screens, trommels, feeders, washing systems, conveyors, and wood/biomass processing equipment for aggregate, mining, recycling, and biomass industries. Products are physically manufactured and delivered globally.

products.name: Specialty Equipment (Material Handlers, Cranes, Concrete Equipment)
products.description: Manufactures material handlers, pick and carry cranes, concrete mixer trucks, volumetric concrete mixers, and concrete pavers for construction, infrastructure, and industrial applications. Products are physically manufactured and delivered to customers.

products.name: Robotic Waste Sorting Equipment
products.description: Produces AI-powered robotic systems for automated waste sorting and recycling applications. Products are manufactured and integrated into recycling facilities.

products.name: Aerial Work Platforms
products.description: Designs and manufactures aerial lifts including portable material lifts, portable aerial work platforms, trailer-mounted articulating booms, self-propelled articulating and telescopic booms, and scissor lifts for elevating workers and materials. Products are physically manufactured and used in construction and maintenance.

products.name: Telehandlers
products.description: Manufactures telehandlers for moving and placing materials on construction sites and in energy and infrastructure industries. Products are physically manufactured and delivered to customers.

products.name: Services and Lifecycle Support (Aerials)
products.description: Provides inspections, preventative maintenance, repairs, refurbishment, modernization, spare parts, consultancy, and training for aerial products and third-party equipment. Services are delivered through in-person labor and parts distribution.

products.name: Equipment Financing Services
products.description: Facilitates equipment financing, including loans, leases, and rentals, to assist customers in procuring Terex equipment. Services are delivered through financial arrangements with third-party institutions and direct customer engagement.

products.name: Workforce Accommodation Services (Villages and Lodges)
products.description: Provision of long-term and temporary lodging, including rooms and hospitality services (food service, housekeeping, maintenance, utilities) at company-owned or customer-owned villages and lodges in remote resource regions. Delivered via physical infrastructure and in-person labor, often under multi-year contracts.

products.name: Hospitality and Facility Management Services at Customer-Owned Sites
products.description: End-to-end or partial hospitality services (catering, food service, housekeeping, site maintenance, laundry, water and wastewater treatment, facility management) provided at customer-owned accommodation facilities, primarily for mining and energy companies. Delivered through on-site personnel and managed service contracts.

products.name: Mobile Accommodation Facility Rental and Services
products.description: Rental of modular, skid-mounted mobile accommodation units and central facilities for short- to medium-term workforce housing needs, including associated hospitality services (food service, housekeeping, camp management). Assets are rapidly deployable and scalable, serving pipeline, drilling, and construction projects.

products.name: Net-Leased Commercial Real Estate Leasing
products.description: NNN acquires, owns, develops, and leases single-tenant, freestanding commercial properties to tenants under long-term, triple-net leases. These leases require tenants to pay operating expenses, and the properties are primarily held for investment. Delivery involves physical acquisition, management, and leasing of real estate assets across the U.S. and Puerto Rico.

products.name: Real Estate Investment and Disposition Services
products.description: NNN invests in, manages, and sells commercial real estate properties, evaluating acquisitions and dispositions based on market conditions, tenant quality, and investment objectives. This involves physical property transactions and financial analysis to optimize the property portfolio.

products.name: Real Estate Mortgage and Loan Investments
products.description: NNN may invest in mortgages, loans secured by real estate or personal property, and securities of other real estate entities, providing capital to third parties secured by real estate assets. This is a financial service involving underwriting and managing real estate-backed debt instruments.
